description_expanded:
Little Dipper | Carriage House - Seaside, FL 30A

13 Odessa Street Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Little Dipper | 13 Odessa Street, is a charming and coastal carriage house in the heart of Seaside Beach, Florida. This cottage is positioned less than a minute walk from the Odessa Pavilion beach access. Enjoy a short bike ride to Seaside Town Center for morning coffee or lunch on Airstream Row. This vacation rental home offers 1 bedroom and a queen sleeper sofa that can accommodate a total of 4 guests.

Little Dipper is a great option for those looking to have a weekend get-a-way or young families traveling to the Emerald Coast. This cottage is complete with its own entrance (shared deck space to access it with the main house), private queen bedroom on the second floor, and a queen size sleeper sofa in the living room. The kitchenette is complete with a 4-burner stove, microwave, coffee maker and refrigerator. This unit also includes a stackable washer and dryer.

*This unit is a carriage house and is rented separately from the main house. The deck around the property is a shared space for access to accommodation. The grill area is a shared space, although separate grills are available for the main house and carriage house. If you are interested in more space, the main house is available to rent, Four By The Shore | 13 Odessa Street

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Carriage House

- Guest bedroom on the second floor with queen sized bed and stackable washer/dryer

- Private bathroom with a walk-in shower

- Kitchenette has a 4 burner stove-top, small dishwasher, microwave, coffee maker, and refrigerator

- Sleep sofa (queen size) in the living room with a tv

Outdoor Space

- Grill (one for main house and one for carriage house)

- One parking pass

- 2 beach cruiser bicycles

Additional

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 to be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
